entities.summary: Edvard Henrik Carleson was a Councilor of Justice and a Councilor of State of the Kingdom of Sweden. He was the son of Jacob Edvard Carleson, Lieutenant Colonel of the Swedish Army, and wife Liboria Fredrika Eleonora Harmens.
